metadata.name: Backend Development
metadata.description: Provides the backend skill and backend-engineer agent for API implementation, data modeling, and service-layer development.

metadata.name: Code Quality
metadata.description: Bundles quality skills and lint/audit/test commands for comprehensive code review, standards compliance, and production readiness checks.

metadata.name: Frankenstein Orchestration
metadata.description: The full multi-agent orchestration suite — all 15 agents, 6 skills, 5 commands, and 6 hooks required to run the Frankenstein pipeline end-to-end.

metadata.name: Frontend Development
metadata.description: Provides frontend, design-authority, and design-lint skills alongside the frontend-engineer agent for UI implementation and design system compliance.

metadata.name: Git Workflow
metadata.description: Combines git-ship and changelog skills with the git-verify command and branch/secrets hooks for a complete git-disciplined workflow.

metadata.name: Infrastructure
metadata.description: Bundles the infra and observability-patterns skills with the site-reliability-engineer agent for infrastructure automation and operational excellence.

metadata.name: Security Hardening
metadata.description: Provides the OWASP reference skill, security-engineer agent, and secrets/config protection hooks for end-to-end security hardening.

metadata.name: Self-Improvement
metadata.description: Aggregates retro, improve, review-skill, and changelog skills with the autoresearch-analyst agent for continuous workflow reflection and improvement.
